data.title: New guide by Anthropic explains deploying Claude AI in sales teams, with 7x ROI case study and three-phase rollout plan.
data.description: Anthropic has released a comprehensive manual detailing the process of implementing Claude AI throughout sales teams. The guide includes a detailed case study showcasing a remarkable Return on Investment (ROI) of 7 times the initial investment. Additionally, it features a structured three-phase strategy for the rollout of the AI system. This resource provides valuable insights for organizations looking to leverage AI in their sales operations effectively.

data.title: MicroTech Named 2026 Corporation of the Year by USHCC
data.description: MicroTech, a prominent Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and technology solutions provider based in Fort Worth, Texas, has recently been crowned the Corporation of the Year for 2026 by the United States Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (USHCC). This prestigious accolade highlights MicroTech's remarkable record of delivering cutting-edge technology solutions over the span of 22 years. The company has been lauded for its support in crucial customer missions, creation of significant economic opportunities, and showcasing the entrepreneurial spirit of America. The recognition underscores the exceptional dedication and impact MicroTech has made in the industry.

data.title: Teledyne Space Imaging Sensors Launch on ESA’s Sentinel-3C and FLEX Missions
data.description: Teledyne Space Imaging technology has been effectively deployed on two significant European Space Agency (ESA) Earth observation missions: Sentinel-3C and the Fluorescence Explorer (FLEX). These satellites were jointly launched this morning via a Vega C rocket from Europe’s Spaceport in French Guiana. Sentinel-3C, the third satellite in the Sentinel-3 series, was created and managed by ESA and is being operated by EUMETSAT to carry out long-term Earth observation.

data.title: InfraTech Capital Advances Development of Global Fiber Optic Manufacturing Platform
data.description: A digital infrastructure investment and development company based in Reston, Virginia, InfraTech Capital, revealed its progress on a new fiber optic manufacturing platform under its InfraTech Cables brand. This initiative is linked to a confidential international infrastructure project and aims to create a hub for manufacturing and exporting advanced fiber optic cable products. The platform is strategically designed to support the development of cutting-edge fiber optic technology, serving a crucial role in the industry's progression.

data.title: Synology Launches Synology Response, Tiered Support From Basic to Mission-Critical Coverage
data.description: In Bellevue, Washington, Synology America introduced Synology Response, a support program tailored for organizations to align their coverage with their systems’ downtime tolerance. This offering includes 24/7 technical support and a promise of a four-hour initial response time. Additionally, higher tiers incorporate advanced hardware replacement and on-site technician service for critical deployments. Synology Response enhances the company’s basic support by offering four service levels, catering to various risk levels in deployments.

data.title: Datavault AI Receives Initial $100 Million Purchase Order for $QEST Tokenization Services
data.description: Datavault AI Inc., a leading company in data monetization, credentialing, digital engagement, and real-world asset tokenization technologies, has disclosed that it recently secured an important milestone. The Company has received an initial purchase order totaling $100 million for its $QEST tokenization services. This purchase order signifies the official launch of Datavault AI's Information Data Exchange®, NILvault™, and American Political Exchange™ services.

data.title: USCIS Grants I-956F Approval to Anasu Resort Phase 2 Rural EB-5 Project by Golden Gate Global
data.description: Golden Gate Global (GGG), a prominent EB-5 regional center in California, has announced that Anasu Resort Phase 2 has obtained Form I-956F approval from the United States Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS). This approval signifies a significant advancement for one of Northern California's leading rural EB-5 projects. USCIS has thoroughly examined the project's EB-5 documentation, job creation strategy, and overall framework, further solidifying its status as a premier development.

data.title: Factory Raises $200 Million at a $5 Billion Valuation to Scale Self-Improving Software Development in the Enterprise
data.description: In San Francisco, the renowned self-improving software development company, Factory, disclosed a notable financial development today. The company secured a substantial $200 million financing from a group of prominent investors including Blackstone, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Insight Partners, Evantic Capital, Sound Ventures, NEA, Mantis VC, Clearlake, along with individual investors like Nico Rosberg, Brad Gerstner, and Marc Benioff. This recent funding round elevates the company's valuation to a striking $5 billion, a substantial increase from its previous valuation of $1.5 billion in April. With this funding, Factory's total investment amount has now surpassed $400 million.
